scope: independent root audit of the actual ordinary-j2 complete moment, target-retaining collapse, chosen-prime Jacobi lift, Fourier support, and semisimple Kummer-rank bound

mathematical_audit.complete_moment: power-sum orthogonality isolates the u-th binomial term and gives the stated complete quadratic moment for every 0<=u<=m
mathematical_audit.target_retention: summing the moments gives H_m, while the p-1 constant terms convert the legitimate Theta to -Theta, so the complete sum is exactly H_m-Theta
mathematical_audit.Jacobi_lift: the Teichmuller characters reduce at the selected prime to the finite-field powers, and the normalization 1/(p-1) is a p-unit

mathematical_audit.rank: the weight has exactly m+1 nonzero multiplicative-character coefficients; orthogonality makes this minimal in the diagonal semisimple Kummer category, and tensoring by the common quadratic factor preserves constituent distinctions
mathematical_audit.positive_rate: Item 344's edge theorem confines sublinear m, and hence sublinear Kummer rank, to o(M) logarithmic mass
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the lower bound classifies exact diagonal semisimple Kummer/Greene lifts of the cutoff weight only; nonlinear, nonsemisimple, p-dependent chosen-prime crystals and linearly growing-conductor distribution remain open
